Susan Lizzotte.b:
Susan Lizzotte returns for her 15th year as the Head Coach for the Black Bears in 2024-25. Lizzotte has been on the coaching staff since her graduation from UMaine in 1999. She graduated with her Bachelors in Kinesiology and Physical Education (KPE) with a concentration in Teaching & Coaching. She took over the program as Head Coach in 2009.
Lizzotte finished an outstanding career swimming for the Black Bears in 1999, and joined the program as an assistant coach in 2000. A four-year MVP of the program, she won four America East individual event titles, set six school records and earned two scholar athlete awards before graduating in 1999. She served as captain her senior year. In 2013, Lizzotte was inducted into the University of Maine Sports Hall of Fame.
Lizzotte also leads a team that excels in the classroom. This past fall, both men and women’s programs had the highest GPA in program history. Multiple Swimmers and Divers have been recognized in elite honor societies on campus such as All Maine Women, Senior Sculls, Sophomore Eagles, and Sophomore Owls.
Lizzotte has guided the Black Bears to break 114 Individual School Records, 50 School Relay Records, multiple Top 10 Performances in school history during her time as head coach.
Her leadership, work ethic and ability to bring out the best in others have made her a great addition to the Head Coaching staff at UMaine. Susan and her husband Jaret, both UMaine Swimming Alumni, have two children, Jackson and Olivia.

Linda Costello.b:
Linda Costello enters her 11th season as the Assistant Coach for the Black Bears in 2025-26. An alumni of UMaine, she graduated summa cum laude in 2012 with her degree in Secondary Education: English and completed her Masters in 2024 in Literacy.
Costello was elevated to associate head coach in August of 2025.
During her time at UMaine, Costello was a captain of the team and a four-time scholar athlete. She was voted the Most Improved in 2008 and earned the Senior Service Award in 2012. Costello finished her 4-year career swimming IM, Backstroke, and Distance for the Black Bears in 2012.
Before joining the coaching staff in 2015, Costello worked for the Athletics Department in Bear Necessities from 2008-2013 as a Student Manager, Ticket Sales in 2012-2013 as the Assistant Director of Marketing Sales and Promotions, and brings experience with many different aspects of the department.
Costello has helped guide the Black Bears to break 58 Individual School Records, 32 School Relay Records, and multiple Top 10 Performances in school history during her time as assistant coach.
Linda and her husband Jefft, both UMaine Alumni, have two golden retrievers, Jake and Luna.

Isaac Forbes.b:
Isaac Forbes enters his 11th season as the Diving Coach for the Black Bears in 2024-25. He coached for the Black Bears first from 2009-2014 and then returned in 2019. An alumni of UMaine, he graduated in 2008 with his Bachelor's degree in English.
Forbes finished his 4-year career diving both 1-Meter and 3-Meter for the Black Bears in 2008. He was a four-time scholar-athlete and in 2007 was voted the Miller Diver Award.
Forbes has guided the Black Bears to school records, Top 10 diving performances in school history, and NCAA Diving Zone Qualifiers.
Isaac and his wife Kristen, both UMaine Diving Alumni, live in Orono with their three children Dylan, Lucas, and Chase.
